def find_permutation(n, p):
    # The fingerprint is determined by the sorted sums of adjacent elements
    # To find a different permutation with the same fingerprint, we can simply reverse the permutation
    return p[::-1]

def main():
    t = int(input())
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input())
        p = list(map(int, input().split()))
        p_prime = find_permutation(n, p)
        print(' '.join(map(str, p_prime)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
